# Hellbender Vinyl

> **Summary:** Boutique / custom collectible-focused pressing plant based in Pittsburgh, PA.
> **Turnaround:** 10–12 weeks.

Hellbender publishes templates and art-submission rules but not audio specs, color catalog, or pricing tiers on its public templates page. Flag the unpublished fields as **"not stated"** and collect from Bill / a Hellbender CSR when needed.

The press catalog matrix (1LP / 2LP / 7" × Color / Splatter / Black, columns 100 / 200 / 300 / 500 / 1000 / 2000) carries Hellbender's full May-2026 quote on 1LP Color + Splatter (every column confirmed from the 1LP PDF) and 2LP Color + Splatter at 500 / 1000 / 2000 (the 2LP PDF didn't quote short-run, so 100 / 200 / 300 stay as yellow placeholders). Black tiers across both formats remain unconfirmed.

## Art file requirements

- **Use Hellbender's own templates. Do not resize or modify them.**
- Files must match the **specific Hellbender template** they were laid out on.
- Acceptable formats:
  - Photoshop PSD
  - EPS
  - TIFF
  - PDF
  - EPS with embedded images and outlined fonts
  - Print-ready PDF with embedded fonts
  - Packaged InDesign with fonts and images
- **Not accepted:** Word, PowerPoint, PhotoDeluxe.
- **No web-sourced images.** 72 dpi is rejected.
- **Dielines must never be embedded or flattened.** Request from PM if a specific dieline is needed.
- Delivery: shareable link (Dropbox, Google Drive, etc.) sent to the project manager.
- Numeric specs (resolution minimum, bleed, color space): not stated — Hellbender enforces via template compliance rather than a published checklist.

## Audio file requirements

Not stated on the templates page. Flag as **"not stated"** and capture from a separate Hellbender source when Bill provides one.

## Packaging options

Implied by the published templates (single, gatefold 1- or 2-pocket, widespine 2×LP, printed inners, inserts, fold-out poster insert). Specific paper weights / coatings / shrinkwrap defaults: **not stated.**

## Color / vinyl options

Six published groups on https://hellbendervinyl.com/pages/custom-vinyl (captured group → colors in `.local/tasks/hellbender-color-groups.json`):

- **Black** — Black
- **House Mix** — House Mix (random recycled blend)
- **Translucent Colors** — Natural, Hazy Orange, Seaglass Blue, Violet
- **Clear Colors** — Clear Pink, Clear Red, Clear Orange, Clear Yellow, Coke Bottle, Clear Green, Clear Blue, Smokey Clear, Ultra Clear
- **Metallic Colors** — Gold, Silver
- **Opaque Colors** — Pink, Maroon, Red, Orange, Peach, Yellow, Duckie Yellow, Lime Green, Green, Dark Green, Jade, Sky Blue, Turquoise, Blue, Deep Purple, Tan, Brown, White

(The live page misspells the third group "Transluscent"; the catalog uses the corrected "Translucent Colors".)

Vinyl weight options: not stated.

## Templates

Hellbender's own templates only — do not resize or modify.

- **12":** Center Label, Single Pocket Jacket, Gatefold Jacket (1 pocket), Gatefold Jacket (2 pocket), Single Pocket Wide-Spine Jacket (2×LP only), Double-sided Single-Page Insert, Double-sided Double-Page Insert (fold-out poster), Printed Inner Sleeves
- **10":** Center Label, Standard Jacket, Gatefold Jacket (1 or 2 pockets), Double-sided Single-Page Insert, Printed Inner Sleeves
- **7":** Center Label, Standard Jacket, Gatefold Jacket (1 or 2 pockets), Double-sided Single-Page Insert, Printed Inner Sleeves
